cases.name: Sherry Holtz
cases.narrative:
On 12/04/1999, a day after she was last seen at a bar in Sanford, FL, her body was found by a person collecting cans in the woods. They discovered Holtz’s body lying on a concrete slab about 20 feet into a wood line in Sanford, FL. 

Her neck was cut, which was determined to be her primary cause of death. She had also suffered blunt force trauma to the head and been strangled, police said, and also had lacerations on her upper body and evidence of severe sexual trauma.

cases.name: Joysee Mar Cartagena Clemente
cases.about: Seminole County Public Schools confirmed that Clemente previously worked for the district as a secretary and a clerk at Spring Lake Elementary School in Altamonte Springs, and then at Lawton Elementary School in Oviedo. FOX 35 spoke with Clemente's son, Steven Rivera Cartagena. He described his mother as his "personal best friend." "My mom was my world to me. That's all I knew, and that's all I wanted to know," he said. "Losing her, it just kind of made me feel like I was an orphan in a way. I was like, 'What do I do?'" Her obituary said, "She was born... in Carolina, Puerto Rico. Joysee will be remembered for her kindness and her ability to make others smile. Many of her friends and coworkers describe her as a "shine of light" in everyone's day. As the oldest of 3 girls, she was a very loving and protective sister and the 3 of them formed an unbreakable bond. She was also an amazing mother who always put the needs of her son first. She protected him fiercely from the negative things in life and made sure he knew every single day how much she loved him. Joysee loved people and made many friends through all phases of her life. She had the ability to connect with people and cultivate lifelong friendships. She maintained many close relationships with her high school classmates from the class of 1991 and those friendships became generational as their children became friends. She will be missed by so many. "
cases.narrative: On 7/17/2023, during a welfare check, she was found with a large zip tie wrapped around her neck.
